```{r workflow prep, echo=FALSE}

# Load packages and functions
library(readxl)
library(openxlsx)
library(tidyverse) 
library(emmeans)
library(car)
library(performance)
library(ggfortify)
library(broom)
library(QuantPsyc)
library(lmtest)
library(patchwork)

source("Functions_Rcode.R")

#Load data
supp <- read_excel("AIMS_Supplement_2025_indices.xlsx")

# Recode condition variables to factors
supp <- supp %>% 
  mutate(condition = as.factor(condition),
         entitytype = as.factor(entitytype),
         mentalfaculty = as.factor(mentalfaculty),
         gender = as.factor(gender),
         raceethnicity = as.factor(raceethnicity),
         region = as.factor(region),
         education_recode = as.factor(education_recode),
         diet = as.factor(diet),
         religion = as.factor(religion),
         religionRNR = as.factor(religionRNR),
         own = as.factor(own),
         work = as.factor(work),
         smart = as.factor(smart)
         )

# Condition assignment numbers
ConditionN <- supp %>% 
  group_by(condition) %>% 
  summarise(no_rows = length(condition))
print(ConditionN)

EntityN <- supp %>% 
  group_by(entitytype) %>% 
  summarise(no_rows = length(entitytype))
print(EntityN)

FacultyN <- supp %>% 
  group_by(mentalfaculty) %>% 
  summarise(no_rows = length(mentalfaculty))
print(FacultyN)

# Comprehension check numbers
Compcheckper <- supp %>%
  group_by(condition, manipcheck1) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
print(Compcheckper)

# Relabel condition categories
Compcheckper <- Compcheckper %>%
  mutate(condition = case_match(condition,
    "agentAI"        ~ "AIs with agency",
    "agentrobot"     ~ "Robots with agency",
    "agentrobotAI"   ~ "Robots/AIs with agency",
    "AI"             ~ "AIs",
    "emotionAI"      ~ "AIs with emotion",
    "emotionrobot"   ~ "Robots with emotion",
    "emotionrobotAI" ~ "Robots/AIs with emotion",
    "reasoningAI"        ~ "AIs with reasoning",
    "reasoningrobot"     ~ "Robots with reasoning",
    "reasoningrobotAI"   ~ "Robots/AIs with reasoning",
    "robot"          ~ "Robots",
    "robotAI"        ~ "Robots/AIs",
    "sentienceAI"        ~ "AIs with sentience",
    "sentiencerobot"     ~ "Robots with sentience",
    "sentiencerobotAI"   ~ "Robots/AIs with sentience",
    .default = condition
  ))

# Generate 15 colorblind-friendly colors using base R 
palette_15 <- hcl.colors(16, palette = "Dark 3")

# Plot
compcheckplot <- ggplot(Compcheckper, aes(x = factor(condition), y = percent, fill = factor(manipcheck1))) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(percent >= 5, paste0(round(percent, 1), "%"), "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            size = 3, color = "white", family = "serif") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = palette_15) +
  labs(
    title = "Percentage of Comprehension Check Responses by Condition",
    x = "Experimental Treatment",
    y = "Percent of Respondents",
    fill = "Response"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "serif"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, family = "serif"),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

compcheckplot

ggsave("manipcheck_stacked.png", plot = compcheckplot, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)

# Variable prep for regressions

# Relevel factor predictors for largest group
supp <- supp %>%
  mutate(
    raceethnicity = fct_relevel(raceethnicity, "White"),
    region = fct_relevel(region, "South"),
    religion = fct_relevel(religion, "Protestant"),
    diet = fct_relevel(diet, "Meat-eater"),
    mentalfaculty = fct_relevel(mentalfaculty, "none"),
    entitytype = fct_relevel(entitytype, "robotAI"))

```

```{r correlations}

set.seed(12345)

# Define the list of dependent variables
dependent_vars <- c("MPC", "MPAC", "AITC", "SARC", "PAAC", 
                    "GAC", "GIC", "GLC", "ATC", "CTC", "PTRC", "PTSC")

# MPC = Mind Perception
# MPAC = Mind Authenticity

# Moral Attitudes
# AITC = Moral Treatment
# SARC = Support for AI Rights
# PAAC = Pro-AI Activism

# Social Attitudes:
# GAC = Godspeed Anthropomorphism
# GLC = Godspeed Likeability
# CTC = Cognitive Trust
# ATC = Affective Trust
# PTRC = Perceived Realistic Threat
# PTSC = Perceived Symbolic Threat

# Create correlation table for mind perception, social attitudes, and moral attitudes
correlation_workbook <- createWorkbook()
options("openxlsx.numFmt" = "0.000")
wrap_format <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.00", wrapText = TRUE)

# Unweighted descriptive statistics (M, SD, N) for each variable
desc_stats <- tibble(
  variable = dependent_vars,
  M  = sapply(dependent_vars, function(v) mean(supp[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)),
  SD = sapply(dependent_vars, function(v) sd(supp[[v]], na.rm = TRUE)),
  N  = sapply(dependent_vars, function(v) sum(!is.na(supp[[v]])))
)

# Unweighted (pairwise-complete) correlation matrix
r_mat <- cor(supp[, dependent_vars], use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

k <- length(dependent_vars)
p_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = k, ncol = k,
                 dimnames = list(dependent_vars, dependent_vars))

for (i in 2:k) {
  for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
    test <- cor.test(supp[[dependent_vars[i]]], supp[[dependent_vars[j]]])
    p_mat[i, j] <- test$p.value
  }
}

# FDR correction (Benjamini-Hochberg) across all pairwise correlations
lower_tri_idx <- which(lower.tri(p_mat), arr.ind = TRUE)   # positions of all tests
raw_p         <- p_mat[lower_tri_idx]
fdr_p         <- p.adjust(raw_p, method = "BH")
 
fdr_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = k, ncol = k,
                   dimnames = list(dependent_vars, dependent_vars))
fdr_mat[lower_tri_idx] <- fdr_p
 
n_tests <- length(raw_p)   # total number of correlations corrected for
n_fdr_sig <- sum(fdr_p < .10)
 
# APA-style formatting helpers
# Correlations (and other 0-1 bounded stats) drop the leading zero per APA 7
apa_r <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x))
}
 
# Means/SDs keep the leading zero
apa_num <- function(x, digits = 2) {
  sprintf(paste0("%.", digits, "f"), x)
}
 
stars_for <- function(p) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    is.na(p) ~ "",
    p < .001 ~ "***",
    p < .01  ~ "**",
    p < .05  ~ "*",
    TRUE     ~ ""
  )
}
 
# Build lower-triangle correlation strings, e.g. ".34**" or ".34**†" if the
# correlation also survives Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction at q < .10
cor_strings <- matrix("", nrow = k, ncol = k,
                       dimnames = list(dependent_vars, dependent_vars))
for (i in 2:k) {
  for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
    fdr_flag <- ifelse(!is.na(fdr_mat[i, j]) && fdr_mat[i, j] < .10, "\u2020", "")
    cor_strings[i, j] <- paste0(apa_r(r_mat[i, j]), stars_for(p_mat[i, j]), fdr_flag)
  }
}
 
# Assemble the APA table
apa_table <- desc_stats %>%
  mutate(
    Variable = paste0(row_number(), ". ", variable),
    M  = apa_num(M),
    SD = apa_num(SD)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Variable, N, M, SD)
 
cor_cols <- as.data.frame(cor_strings[, 1:(k - 1), drop = FALSE],
                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
names(cor_cols) <- as.character(1:(k - 1))
 
apa_table <- bind_cols(apa_table, cor_cols)
 
# Write to Excel
addWorksheet(correlation_workbook, "APA Correlations")
 
writeData(
  correlation_workbook, "APA Correlations", apa_table,
  startRow = 1, startCol = 1, headerStyle = wrap_format
)
 
addStyle(correlation_workbook, "APA Correlations", wrap_format,
         rows = 1, cols = 1:ncol(apa_table), gridExpand = TRUE)
 
setColWidths(
  correlation_workbook, "APA Correlations",
  cols = 1:ncol(apa_table),
  widths = c(16, 6, 6, 6, rep(6, k - 1))
)
 
# Variable key + significance legend, placed a couple of rows below the table
note_row <- nrow(apa_table) + 3
var_key <- paste(paste0(seq_along(dependent_vars), " = ", dependent_vars), collapse = "; ")
 
writeData(
  correlation_workbook, "APA Correlations",
  paste0("Note. ", var_key, ". *p < .05, **p < .01, ***p < .001. ",
         "\u2020 correlation remains significant after Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction ",
         "for all ", n_tests, " correlations conducted (q < .10; ", n_fdr_sig,
         " of ", n_tests, " correlations survived correction). All statistics reported here ",
         "are unweighted."),
  startRow = note_row, startCol = 1
)
 
mergeCells(correlation_workbook, "APA Correlations",
           cols = 1:ncol(apa_table), rows = note_row)
addStyle(correlation_workbook, "APA Correlations",
         createStyle(wrapText = TRUE, valign = "top"),
         rows = note_row, cols = 1:ncol(apa_table))
setRowHeights(correlation_workbook, "APA Correlations", rows = note_row, heights = 60)
 
# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(correlation_workbook, "correlations_paper_unweighted.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

```

```{r regressions}

set.seed(12345)
 
# Define the list of dependent variables
dependent_vars <- c("MPC", "MPAC", "AITC", "SARC", "PAAC", 
                    "GAC", "GIC", "GLC", "ATC", "CTC", "PTRC", "PTSC")
 
# MPC = Mind Perception
# MPAC = Mind Authenticity
 
# Moral Attitudes:
# AITC = Moral Treatment
# SARC = Support for AI Rights
# PAAC = Pro-AI Activism
 
# Social Attitudes:
# GAC = Godspeed Anthropomorphism
# GLC = Godspeed Likeability
# GIC = Godspeed Intelligence
# CTC = Cognitive Trust
# ATC = Affective Trust
# PTRC = Perceived Realistic Threat
# PTSC = Perceived Symbolic Threat
 
# Panel titles and tags
title_map <- c(
  MPC  = "Mind Perception",
  MPAC = "Mind Authenticity",
  AITC = "Moral Treatment",
  SARC = "Support for AI Rights",
  PAAC = "Pro-AI Activism",
  GAC  = "Godspeed Anthropomorphism",
  GLC  = "Godspeed Likability",
  GIC  = "Godspeed Intelligence",
  CTC  = "Cognitive Trust",
  ATC  = "Affective Trust",
  PTRC = "Realistic Threat",
  PTSC = "Symbolic Threat"
)
 
tag_map <- c(
  MPC  = "A",
  MPAC = "B",
  AITC = "A",
  SARC = "B",
  PAAC = "C",
  GAC  = "A",
  GLC  = "B",
  GIC  = "C",
  CTC  = "D",
  ATC  = "E",
  PTRC = "F",
  PTSC = "G"
)
 
# Per-variable scale specs (min, max, and axis breaks) for each DV y-axes
scale_specs <- list(
  MPC  = list(min = 0, max = 100, breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25)),
  MPAC = list(min = 0, max = 100, breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25)),
  AITC = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  SARC = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  PAAC = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  GAC  = list(min = 0, max = 10,  breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2.5)),
  GLC  = list(min = 0, max = 10,  breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2.5)),
  GIC  = list(min = 0, max = 10,  breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2.5)),
  CTC  = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  ATC  = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  PTRC = list(min = 0, max = 100, breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25)),
  PTSC = list(min = 0, max = 100, breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25))
)
 
# Reusable paper theme layer for plots
paper_theme <- function(title, tag, y_min, y_max, y_breaks) {
  headroom <- 0.05 * (y_max - y_min)
  list(
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_max + headroom)),
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks),
    theme_classic(base_family = "serif"),
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, vjust = 1, margin = margin(b = 3), size = 18, family = "serif", face = "plain"),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.tag = element_text(hjust = 0, vjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 5), size = 18, family = "serif", face = "plain"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, b = 5),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(family = "serif", face = "plain", size = 14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
      legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", face = "plain", size = 14),
      legend.title = element_blank()
    ),
    labs(title = title, tag = tag)
  )
}
 
# Helper functions for reporting statistics
 
# Compute standardized ("beta") coefficients for an lm model. This
# standardizes both the outcome and every column of the model matrix
# (including dummy-coded factor levels), then rescales the unstandardized
# coefficients:
#   beta_std_j = beta_j * sd(x_j) / sd(y)
# Note: standardized coefficients for dummy-coded categorical predictors
# should be interpreted with some caution (this is the same convention
# used by packages like lm.beta for ordinary lm() models).
compute_std_betas <- function(model_obj) {
  mm <- model.matrix(model_obj)
  y  <- model.response(model.frame(model_obj))
 
  sd_y <- sd(y)
  coefs <- coef(model_obj)
 
  std_betas <- sapply(names(coefs), function(term) {
    if (term == "(Intercept)") return(NA_real_)
    sd_x <- sd(mm[, term])
    unname(coefs[term]) * sd_x / sd_y
  })
  std_betas
}
 
# Create workbook
mfe_regression_workbook <- createWorkbook()
options("openxlsx.numFmt" = "0.000")
wrap_format <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.00", wrapText = TRUE)
 
# Create an empty list to store results
results_list_mfe <- list()
 
# Create an empty list to hold the individual plots
plots_mf <- list()
plots_et <- list()
 
 
# Create directory for plots if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists("adjusted main effects plots unweighted")) {
  dir.create("adjusted main effects plots unweighted")
}
 
# Loop through each dependent variable
for (dv in dependent_vars) {
  
  # Create formula dynamically
  formula_mfe <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~ agecen + gender + raceethnicity + intcen + 
                                  mentalfaculty + entitytype"))
  
  # Restrict the data to rows with complete data on the DV and all
  # predictors, so that the full model and the null (intercept-only) model
  # used for R^2 below are fit on exactly the same sample.
  vars_needed <- c(dv, "agecen", "gender", "raceethnicity", "intcen",
                    "mentalfaculty", "entitytype")
  complete_idx <- complete.cases(supp[, vars_needed])
  data_dv <- supp[complete_idx, ]
  
  # Fit model (unweighted OLS)
  model_mfe <- lm(formula = formula_mfe, data = data_dv)
  
  # R^2 for the unweighted model
  r2_mfe <- summary(model_mfe)$r.squared
  
  # Omnibus F-statistic and its degrees of freedom (numerator, denominator)
  f_mfe <- summary(model_mfe)$fstatistic
  
  # p-value for the omnibus F-test
  f_pvalue_mfe <- pf(f_mfe[["value"]], f_mfe[["numdf"]], f_mfe[["dendf"]], lower.tail = FALSE)
  
  # Degrees of freedom used for the coefficient t-tests
  df_mfe <- df.residual(model_mfe)
  
  # Standardized beta coefficients
  std_beta_mfe <- compute_std_betas(model_mfe)
  
  # Get confidence intervals
  ci_mf <- confint(model_mfe)
  
  # Tidy model results
  m_mfe <- tidy(model_mfe)
  ci_mfe <- as.data.frame(ci_mf)
  names(ci_mfe) <- c("conf.low", "conf.high")
  
  # Append confidence intervals to results table
  m_mfe <- cbind(m_mfe, ci_mfe)
  
  # Add standardized beta (matched to term names), R-squared, F-stats, and df for
  # APA-style reporting
  m_mfe$std.beta  <- std_beta_mfe[m_mfe$term]
  m_mfe$r.squared <- r2_mfe
  m_mfe$df        <- df_mfe
    m_mfe$f.stat    <- f_mfe[["value"]]
  m_mfe$f.df.num  <- f_mfe[["numdf"]]
  m_mfe$f.df.den  <- f_mfe[["dendf"]]
  m_mfe$f.pvalue  <- f_pvalue_mfe
  
  # Add significance stars based on raw p-values
  m_mfe$sig <- get_sig_stars(m_mfe$p.value)
  
  # Add FDR-corrected p-values
  m_mfe$p.fdr <- p.adjust(m_mfe$p.value, method = "fdr")
  m_mfe$sig.fdr <- get_sig_stars(m_mfe$p.fdr)
 
  
  # Store results in list
  results_list_mfe[[dv]] <- m_mfe
  
  # Add worksheet for each dependent variable
  addWorksheet(mfe_regression_workbook, dv)
  writeData(mfe_regression_workbook, sheet = dv, m_mfe)
  
  #-----------------------------------------------------------
  # Create adjusted means violin plots for mental faculty
  #-----------------------------------------------------------
  
  # Use emmeans to get adjusted means for mental faculty
  emm_mf <- emmeans(model_mfe, ~ mentalfaculty, 
                    nuisance = c("gender", "raceethnicity"),
                    at = list(agecen = 0))
  pred_data_mf <- as.data.frame(emm_mf)
  
  # Rename columns and create confidence bands
  pred_data_mf <- pred_data_mf %>%
    rename(fitted = emmean, se = SE) %>%
    mutate(
      lower = fitted - se,
      upper = fitted + se,
      mentalfaculty_label = case_when(
        mentalfaculty == "none" ~ "Control",
        mentalfaculty == "agent" ~ "Agency",
        mentalfaculty == "emotion" ~ "Emotion",
        mentalfaculty == "reasoning" ~ "Reasoning",
        mentalfaculty == "sentience" ~ "Sentience",
        TRUE ~ as.character(mentalfaculty)
      ),
      mentalfaculty_label = factor(mentalfaculty_label,
                                  levels = c("Sentience", "Emotion", "Reasoning", "Agency", "Control"))
    )
  
  # Prepare raw data for violin plot
  raw_data_mf <- supp %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(dv)) & !is.na(mentalfaculty)) %>%
    mutate(
      mentalfaculty_label = case_when(
        mentalfaculty == "none" ~ "Control",
        mentalfaculty == "agent" ~ "Agency",
        mentalfaculty == "emotion" ~ "Emotion",
        mentalfaculty == "reasoning" ~ "Reasoning",
        mentalfaculty == "sentience" ~ "Sentience",
        TRUE ~ as.character(mentalfaculty)
      ),
      mentalfaculty_label = factor(mentalfaculty_label,
                                  levels = c("Sentience", "Emotion", "Reasoning", "Agency", "Control"))
    )
  
  # Perform pairwise comparisons for mental faculty
  pairs_mf <- pairs(emm_mf, adjust = "none")
  pairs_mf_df <- as.data.frame(pairs_mf)
  
  # Add significance stars to comparisons
  pairs_mf_df$sig <- ifelse(pairs_mf_df$p.value < 0.001, "***",
                            ifelse(pairs_mf_df$p.value < 0.01, "**",
                                   ifelse(pairs_mf_df$p.value < 0.05, "*", "")))
  
  # Filter for significant comparisons only
  sig_pairs_mf <- pairs_mf_df %>% filter(sig != "")
  
  # Plot violin plot with adjusted means for mental faculty
  p_adj_mf <- ggplot() +
    geom_violin(data = raw_data_mf, 
                aes(x = mentalfaculty_label, y = !!sym(dv)), 
                fill = "#FFD700", alpha = 0.3, color = "#FFD700") +
    geom_point(data = pred_data_mf, 
               aes(x = mentalfaculty_label, y = fitted), 
               size = 4, color = "#FFD700") +
    geom_errorbar(data = pred_data_mf, 
                  aes(x = mentalfaculty_label, ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
                  width = 0.2, linewidth = 1, color = "#FFD700") +
    labs(x = "Mental Faculty")
  
  # Add significance bars if there are significant comparisons
  if (nrow(sig_pairs_mf) > 0) {
    # Get the y-axis range for positioning significance bars
    y_range <- range(raw_data_mf[[dv]], na.rm = TRUE)
    y_max <- max(pred_data_mf$upper, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_step <- (y_range[2] - y_max) / (nrow(sig_pairs_mf) + 2)
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(sig_pairs_mf)) {
      # Parse the contrast to get group names
      contrast_parts <- strsplit(as.character(sig_pairs_mf$contrast[i]), " - ")[[1]]
      group1 <- gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", contrast_parts[1])
      group2 <- gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", contrast_parts[2])
      
      # Map to labels
      group1_label <- pred_data_mf$mentalfaculty_label[pred_data_mf$mentalfaculty == group1][1]
      group2_label <- pred_data_mf$mentalfaculty_label[pred_data_mf$mentalfaculty == group2][1]
      
      if (!is.na(group1_label) && !is.na(group2_label)) {
        x1 <- which(levels(factor(pred_data_mf$mentalfaculty_label)) == group1_label)
        x2 <- which(levels(factor(pred_data_mf$mentalfaculty_label)) == group2_label)
        
        y_pos <- y_max + (i * y_step)
        
        p_adj_mf <- p_adj_mf +
          annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x1, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("segment", x = x2, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("text", x = (x1 + x2)/2, y = y_pos + y_step/4, 
                   label = sig_pairs_mf$sig[i], size = 5)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Apply the shared "paper" theme (serif font, coord_cartesian, breaks,
  # short title, panel tag) using this DV's own scale
  spec_dv <- scale_specs[[dv]]
  p_adj_mf <- p_adj_mf + paper_theme(title_map[[dv]], tag_map[[dv]],
                                      spec_dv$min, spec_dv$max, spec_dv$breaks)
  
  # Store for later combining
  plots_mf[[dv]] <- p_adj_mf
  
  # Save plot
  ggsave(filename = paste0("adjusted main effects plots unweighted/", dv, "_mentalfaculty_paper.png"),
         plot = p_adj_mf,
         width = 8,
         height = 6,
         dpi = 300)
 
  #-----------------------------------------------------------
  # Create adjusted means violin plots for entity type
  #-----------------------------------------------------------
  
  # Use emmeans to get adjusted means for entity type
  emm_et <- emmeans(model_mfe, ~ entitytype, 
                    nuisance = c("gender", "raceethnicity"),
                    at = list(agecen = 0, incomecen = 0, polcen = 0))
  pred_data_et <- as.data.frame(emm_et)
  
  # Rename columns, recode entity-type labels, and create confidence bands
  pred_data_et <- pred_data_et %>%
    rename(fitted = emmean, se = SE) %>%
    mutate(
      lower = fitted - se,
      upper = fitted + se,
      entitytype_label = case_when(
        as.character(entitytype) == "AI" ~ "AIs",
        as.character(entitytype) == "robot" ~ "Robots",
        as.character(entitytype) == "robotAI" ~ "Robots/AIs",
        TRUE ~ as.character(entitytype)
      )
    )
  
  # Prepare raw data for violin plot (same relabeling)
  raw_data_et <- supp %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(dv)) & !is.na(entitytype)) %>%
    mutate(
      entitytype_label = case_when(
        as.character(entitytype) == "AI" ~ "AIs",
        as.character(entitytype) == "robot" ~ "Robots",
        as.character(entitytype) == "robotAI" ~ "Robots/AIs",
        TRUE ~ as.character(entitytype)
      )
    )
  
  # Perform pairwise comparisons for entity type
  pairs_et <- pairs(emm_et, adjust = "none")
  pairs_et_df <- as.data.frame(pairs_et)
  
  # Add significance stars to comparisons
  pairs_et_df$sig <- ifelse(pairs_et_df$p.value < 0.001, "***",
                            ifelse(pairs_et_df$p.value < 0.01, "**",
                                   ifelse(pairs_et_df$p.value < 0.05, "*", "")))
  
  # Filter for significant comparisons only
  sig_pairs_et <- pairs_et_df %>% filter(sig != "")
  
  # Plot violin plot with adjusted means for entity type
  p_adj_et <- ggplot() +
    geom_violin(data = raw_data_et, 
                aes(x = entitytype_label, y = !!sym(dv)), 
                fill = "#1A1A2E", alpha = 0.3, color = "#1A1A2E") +
    geom_point(data = pred_data_et, 
               aes(x = entitytype_label, y = fitted), 
               size = 4, color = "#1A1A2E") +
    geom_errorbar(data = pred_data_et, 
                  aes(x = entitytype_label, ymin = lower, ymax = upper), 
                  width = 0.2, linewidth = 1, color = "#1A1A2E") +
    labs(x = "Entity Type")
  
  # Add significance bars if there are significant comparisons
  if (nrow(sig_pairs_et) > 0) {
    # Get the y-axis range for positioning significance bars
    y_range <- range(raw_data_et[[dv]], na.rm = TRUE)
    y_max <- max(pred_data_et$upper, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_step <- (y_range[2] - y_max) / (nrow(sig_pairs_et) + 2)
    
    for (i in 1:nrow(sig_pairs_et)) {
      # Parse the contrast to get group names
      contrast_parts <- strsplit(as.character(sig_pairs_et$contrast[i]), " - ")[[1]]
      group1 <- gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", contrast_parts[1])
      group2 <- gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", contrast_parts[2])
      
      # Map to labels 
      group1_label <- pred_data_et$entitytype_label[pred_data_et$entitytype == group1][1]
      group2_label <- pred_data_et$entitytype_label[pred_data_et$entitytype == group2][1]
      
      if (!is.na(group1_label) && !is.na(group2_label)) {
        x1 <- which(levels(factor(pred_data_et$entitytype_label)) == group1_label)
        x2 <- which(levels(factor(pred_data_et$entitytype_label)) == group2_label)
        
        y_pos <- y_max + (i * y_step)
        
        p_adj_et <- p_adj_et +
          annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x1, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("segment", x = x2, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("text", x = (x1 + x2)/2, y = y_pos + y_step/4, 
                   label = sig_pairs_et$sig[i], size = 5)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Apply the shared paper theme
  p_adj_et <- p_adj_et + paper_theme(title_map[[dv]], tag_map[[dv]],
                                      spec_dv$min, spec_dv$max, spec_dv$breaks)
  
  # Store for later combining
  plots_et[[dv]] <- p_adj_et
  
  # Save plot
  ggsave(filename = paste0("adjusted main effects plots unweighted/", dv, "_entitytype_paper.png"),
         plot = p_adj_et,
         width = 8,
         height = 6,
         dpi = 300)
}

```{r ANOVAs}
#-----------
# 5x3 ANOVAs
#-----------
 
library(effectsize)
 
set.seed(12345)
 
# Set sum-to-zero contrasts to interpret Type 3 ANOVAs
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
 
# Ensure correct factor order for Type 3 ANOVAs
supp$entitytype <- factor(supp$entitytype, levels = c("AI", "robot", "robotAI"))
supp$mentalfaculty <- factor(supp$mentalfaculty, levels = (c("agent", "emotion", "reasoning",
                                                             "sentience", "none")))
 
# Define the list of dependent variables
dependent_vars <- c(
  "MPC",
  "MPAC",
  "AITC",
  "SARC",
  "PAAC",
  "GAC",
  "GIC",
  "GLC",
  "ATC",
  "CTC",
  "PTRC",
  "PTSC")
 
#-------------
# Descriptives
#-------------
 
# Create an empty list to store descriptive stats
descrip_entitytype_list <- list()
descrip_mentalfaculty_list <- list()
descrip_condition_list <- list()
 
# Create descriptives workbook
descriptives_workbook <- createWorkbook()
options("openxlsx.numFmt" = "0.000")
wrap_format <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.00", wrapText = TRUE)
 
 
# Unweighted descriptives helper: mean/SE/SD, n, min, max computed directly
# on the raw (unweighted) data.
get_descriptives <- function(var, group, data) {
  data %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[var]])) %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(group))) %>%
    summarise(
      n    = n(),
      mean = mean(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      sd   = sd(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      min  = min(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      max  = max(.data[[var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(se = sd / sqrt(n)) %>%
    rename(Group = !!group) %>%
    mutate(Group = as.character(Group),
           Variable = var,
           GroupType = group) %>%
    dplyr::select(Variable, Group, GroupType, n, mean, se, sd, min, max)
}
 
# Loop through dependent variable for descriptives
for (var in dependent_vars) {
 
  descriptives_entitytype <- get_descriptives(var, "entitytype", supp)
  descriptives_mentalfaculty <- get_descriptives(var, "mentalfaculty", supp)
  descriptives_condition <- get_descriptives(var, "condition", supp)
 
  # Store in respective lists
  descrip_entitytype_list[[var]] <- descriptives_entitytype
  descrip_mentalfaculty_list[[var]] <- descriptives_mentalfaculty
  descrip_condition_list[[var]] <- descriptives_condition
}
 
# Combine each list into a single data frame
df_entitytype <- do.call(rbind, descrip_entitytype_list)
df_mentalfaculty <- do.call(rbind, descrip_mentalfaculty_list)
df_condition <- do.call(rbind, descrip_condition_list)
 
rownames(df_entitytype) <- NULL
rownames(df_mentalfaculty) <- NULL
rownames(df_condition) <- NULL
 
# Export to Excel with multiple sheets
# Add EntityType sheet
addWorksheet(descriptives_workbook, "EntityType")
writeData(descriptives_workbook, "EntityType", df_entitytype)
addStyle(descriptives_workbook, "EntityType", wrap_format,
         rows = 2:(nrow(df_entitytype) + 1),
         cols = 1:ncol(df_entitytype), gridExpand = TRUE)
setColWidths(descriptives_workbook, "EntityType",
             cols = 1:ncol(df_entitytype), widths = "auto")
 
# Add MentalFaculty sheet
addWorksheet(descriptives_workbook, "MentalFaculty")
writeData(descriptives_workbook, "MentalFaculty", df_mentalfaculty)
addStyle(descriptives_workbook, "MentalFaculty", wrap_format,
         rows = 2:(nrow(df_mentalfaculty) + 1),
         cols = 1:ncol(df_mentalfaculty), gridExpand = TRUE)
setColWidths(descriptives_workbook, "MentalFaculty",
             cols = 1:ncol(df_mentalfaculty), widths = "auto")
 
# Add Condition sheet
addWorksheet(descriptives_workbook, "Condition")
writeData(descriptives_workbook, "Condition", df_condition)
addStyle(descriptives_workbook, "Condition", wrap_format,
         rows = 2:(nrow(df_condition) + 1),
         cols = 1:ncol(df_condition), gridExpand = TRUE)
setColWidths(descriptives_workbook, "Condition",
             cols = 1:ncol(df_condition), widths = "auto")
 
# Save workbook
saveWorkbook(descriptives_workbook, "descriptive_statistics_by_groups_paper_unweighted.xlsx",
             overwrite = TRUE)
 
#-------
# ANOVAS
#-------
 
# Define the list of dependent variables with descriptive names
dependent_vars <- list(
  MPC = "Mind Perception",
  MPAC = "Mind Authenticity",
  AITC = "Moral Treatment",
  SARC = "Support for AI Rights",
  PAAC = "Pro-AI Activism",
  GAC = "Godspeed Anthropomorphism",
  GIC = "Godspeed Intelligence",
  GLC = "Godspeed Likability",
  ATC = "Affective Trust",
  CTC = "Cognitive Trust",
  PTRC = "Realistic Threat",
  PTSC = "Symbolic Threat")
 
 
# Panel titles and tags
title_map <- c(
  MPC  = "Mind Perception",
  MPAC = "Mind Authenticity",
  AITC = "Moral Treatment",
  SARC = "Support for AI Rights",
  PAAC = "Pro-AI Activism",
  GAC  = "Godspeed Anthropomorphism",
  GLC  = "Godspeed Likability",
  GIC  = "Godspeed Intelligence",
  CTC  = "Cognitive Trust",
  ATC  = "Affective Trust",
  PTRC = "Realistic Threat",
  PTSC = "Symbolic Threat"
)
 
tag_map <- c(
  MPC  = "A",
  MPAC = "B",
  AITC = "A",
  SARC = "B",
  PAAC = "C",
  GAC  = "A",
  GLC  = "B",
  GIC  = "C",
  CTC  = "D",
  ATC  = "E",
  PTRC = "F",
  PTSC = "G"
)
 
# Per-variable scale specs (min, max, and axis breaks)
scale_specs <- list(
  MPC  = list(min = 0, max = 100, breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25)),
  MPAC = list(min = 0, max = 100, breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25)),
  AITC = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  SARC = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  PAAC = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  GAC  = list(min = 0, max = 10,  breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2.5)),
  GLC  = list(min = 0, max = 10,  breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2.5)),
  GIC  = list(min = 0, max = 10,  breaks = seq(0, 10, by = 2.5)),
  CTC  = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  ATC  = list(min = 1, max = 7,   breaks = seq(1, 7, by = 1)),
  PTRC = list(min = 0, max = 100, breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25)),
  PTSC = list(min = 0, max = 100, breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 25))
)
 
# Reusable paper theme layer
paper_theme <- function(title, tag, y_min, y_max, y_breaks, show_legend = FALSE) {
  headroom <- 0.05 * (y_max - y_min)
  list(
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(y_min, y_max + headroom)),
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks),
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = 0.15)),
    theme_classic(base_family = "serif"),
    theme(
      legend.position = if (show_legend) "bottom" else "none",
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, vjust = 1, margin = margin(b = 3), size = 18, family = "serif", face = "plain"),
      plot.title.position = "plot",
      plot.tag = element_text(hjust = 0, vjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 5), size = 18, family = "serif", face = "plain"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 5, b = 5),
      axis.title.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(family = "serif", face = "plain", size = 14),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1),
      legend.text = element_text(family = "serif", face = "plain", size = 14),
      legend.title = element_blank()
    ),
    labs(title = title, tag = tag)
  )
}
 
# Relabel helpers
recode_entitytype <- function(x) {
  case_when(
    as.character(x) == "AI" ~ "AIs",
    as.character(x) == "robot" ~ "Robots",
    as.character(x) == "robotAI" ~ "Robots/AIs",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
}
 
recode_mentalfaculty <- function(x) {
  out <- case_when(
    x == "none" ~ "Control",
    x == "agent" ~ "Agency",
    x == "emotion" ~ "Emotion",
    x == "reasoning" ~ "Reasoning",
    x == "sentience" ~ "Sentience",
    TRUE ~ as.character(x)
  )
  factor(out, levels = c("Sentience", "Emotion", "Reasoning", "Agency", "Control"))
}
 
# Create workbook
expsection_anovas_workbook <- createWorkbook()
options("openxlsx.numFmt" = "0.000")
wrap_format <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.00", wrapText = TRUE)
 
# Create an empty list to store results
results_list_expaov <- list()
plots_list_expaov <- list()
 
# Create directory for plots if it doesn't exist
if (!dir.exists("experimental anova plots unweighted")) {
  dir.create("experimental anova plots unweighted")
}
 
# Loop through each dependent variable
for (var_name in names(dependent_vars)) {
 
  sheet_name <- dependent_vars[[var_name]]
  spec_dv <- scale_specs[[var_name]]
 
  # Create formula dynamically — experimental factors + demographic covariates
  # agecen and intcen are continuous; gender and raceethnicity are multicategorical (sum contrasts)
  formula_expaov <- as.formula(paste(
    var_name,
    "~ entitytype + mentalfaculty + entitytype:mentalfaculty",
    "+ agecen + gender + raceethnicity + intcen"
  ))
 
  # Run unweighted linear model
  model_expaov <- lm(formula_expaov, data = supp, na.action = na.omit)
 
  # Type 3 ANOVA
  expaov_result <- car::Anova(model_expaov, type = 3)
 
  # Tidy results
  tidy_expaov <- tidy(expaov_result)
 
  # Add FDR-corrected p-values
  tidy_expaov$p.fdr <- p.adjust(tidy_expaov$p.value, method = "fdr")
  tidy_expaov$sig <- get_sig_stars(tidy_expaov$p.value)
  tidy_expaov$sig.fdr <- get_sig_stars(tidy_expaov$p.fdr)
 
  # effectsize::eta_squared() computes partial eta-squared with a noncentral-F
  # based confidence interval directly from the car::Anova() object.
  eta_sq_expaov <- effectsize::eta_squared(expaov_result, partial = TRUE, ci = 0.95) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::rename(term = Parameter,
                  partial_eta_sq = Eta2_partial,
                  eta_sq_ci_low = CI_low,
                  eta_sq_ci_high = CI_high) %>%
    dplyr::select(term, partial_eta_sq, eta_sq_ci_low, eta_sq_ci_high)
 
  # Residual df (denominator df), same across all terms, used for APA F string
  residual_df_expaov <- tidy_expaov$df[tidy_expaov$term == "Residuals"]
 
  tidy_expaov <- tidy_expaov %>%
    left_join(eta_sq_expaov, by = "term") %>%
    mutate(
      apa_effect_size = ifelse(
        !is.na(partial_eta_sq),
        sprintf("\u03b7\u00b2p = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]",
                partial_eta_sq, eta_sq_ci_low, eta_sq_ci_high),
        NA_character_
      ),
      apa_full = ifelse(
        !is.na(partial_eta_sq),
        sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f, p %s, \u03b7\u00b2p = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]",
                df, residual_df_expaov, statistic,
                ifelse(p.value < .001, "< .001", paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))),
                partial_eta_sq, eta_sq_ci_low, eta_sq_ci_high),
        NA_character_
      )
    )
  # ============================================================================
 
  print(tidy_expaov)
 
 
  # Pairwise comparisons
  emm_entity_expaov <- emmeans(model_expaov, pairwise ~ entitytype, adjust = "none")
  emm_mentalfaculty_expaov <- emmeans(model_expaov, pairwise ~ mentalfaculty, adjust = "none")
  emm_entity_by_mf_expaov <- emmeans(model_expaov, ~ entitytype | mentalfaculty)
  pairwise_results_expaov <- pairs(emm_entity_by_mf_expaov, adjust = "none")
 
  # All pairwise comparisons across both factors
  emm_interaction_expaov <- emmeans(model_expaov, ~ entitytype:mentalfaculty)
  pairwise_results_expaov2 <- pairs(emm_interaction_expaov, adjust = "none")
 
  # infer = c(TRUE, TRUE) returns both the CI (lower.CL/upper.CL) and the
  # test statistic/p-value in a single summary data frame 
  entity_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(summary(emm_entity_expaov$contrasts, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  mentalfaculty_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(summary(emm_mentalfaculty_expaov$contrasts, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  entity_by_mf_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pairwise_results_expaov, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  interaction_contrasts_df <- as.data.frame(summary(pairwise_results_expaov2, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
 
  apa_mdiff <- function(df) {
    df %>% mutate(apa_contrast = sprintf("Mdiff = %.2f, 95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f], p %s",
                                          estimate, lower.CL, upper.CL,
                                          ifelse(p.value < .001, "< .001",
                                                 paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p.value)))))
  }
  entity_contrasts_df <- apa_mdiff(entity_contrasts_df)
  mentalfaculty_contrasts_df <- apa_mdiff(mentalfaculty_contrasts_df)
  entity_by_mf_contrasts_df <- apa_mdiff(entity_by_mf_contrasts_df)
  interaction_contrasts_df <- apa_mdiff(interaction_contrasts_df)
  # ===============================================================================
 
  # Store results
  results_list_expaov[[var_name]] <- list(
    model_expaov = model_expaov,
    anova_expaov = tidy_expaov,
    eta_sq_expaov = eta_sq_expaov,                            # NEW
    emm_entity_expaov = emm_entity_expaov,
    emm_mentalfaculty_expaov = emm_mentalfaculty_expaov,
    emm_entity_by_mf_expaov = emm_entity_by_mf_expaov,
    pairwise_results_expaov = pairwise_results_expaov,
    entity_contrasts_df = entity_contrasts_df,                # NEW
    mentalfaculty_contrasts_df = mentalfaculty_contrasts_df,  # NEW
    entity_by_mf_contrasts_df = entity_by_mf_contrasts_df,     # NEW
    interaction_contrasts_df = interaction_contrasts_df        # NEW
  )
 
  # ==================== WRITE APA SUMMARY TO WORKBOOK ====================
  addWorksheet(expsection_anovas_workbook, sheet_name)
  current_row <- 1
 
  writeData(expsection_anovas_workbook, sheet_name,
            "ANOVA Results (with partial eta-squared and 95% CI)", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1
  writeData(expsection_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, tidy_expaov, startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + nrow(tidy_expaov) + 3
 
  writeData(expsection_anovas_workbook, sheet_name,
            "Pairwise Contrasts: Entity Type (with 95% CI)", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1
  writeData(expsection_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, entity_contrasts_df, startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + nrow(entity_contrasts_df) + 3
 
  writeData(expsection_anovas_workbook, sheet_name,
            "Pairwise Contrasts: Mental Faculty (with 95% CI)", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1
  writeData(expsection_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, mentalfaculty_contrasts_df, startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + nrow(mentalfaculty_contrasts_df) + 3
 
  writeData(expsection_anovas_workbook, sheet_name,
            "Pairwise Contrasts: Entity Type within Mental Faculty (with 95% CI)", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1

  current_row <- current_row + nrow(entity_by_mf_contrasts_df) + 3
 
  writeData(expsection_anovas_workbook, sheet_name,
            "Pairwise Contrasts: Entity Type x Mental Faculty, all cells (with 95% CI)", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1

  # ==================== CREATE PLOTS ====================
 
  # Main Effect of Entity Type
 
  raw_data_entity <- supp %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var_name)) & !is.na(entitytype)) %>%

    rename(fitted = emmean, se = SE) %>%
    mutate(
      lower = fitted - se,

      entitytype_label = recode_entitytype(entitytype)
    )
 
  pairs_entity_df <- as.data.frame(emm_entity_expaov$contrasts)
  sig_entity <- pairs_entity_df %>% filter(p.value < 0.05)
 
  p1 <- ggplot() +
    geom_violin(data = raw_data_entity,

    geom_errorbar(data = emm_entity_df,
                  aes(x = entitytype_label, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
                  width = 0.2, linewidth = 1, color = "#1A1A2E") +
    labs(x = "Entity Type")
 
  # Add significance bars if there are significant comparisons
  if (nrow(sig_entity) > 0) {
    y_range <- range(raw_data_entity[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
    y_max <- max(emm_entity_df$upper, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_step <- (y_range[2] - y_max) / (nrow(sig_entity) + 2)
 
    for (i in 1:nrow(sig_entity)) {
      contrast_parts <- strsplit(as.character(sig_entity$contrast[i]), " - ")[[1]]
      group1 <- trimws(gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", contrast_parts[1]))
      group2 <- trimws(gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", contrast_parts[2]))
 
      group1_label <- emm_entity_df$entitytype_label[as.character(emm_entity_df$entitytype) == group1][1]
      group2_label <- emm_entity_df$entitytype_label[as.character(emm_entity_df$entitytype) == group2][1]
 
      if (!is.na(group1_label) && !is.na(group2_label)) {
        x1 <- which(levels(factor(emm_entity_df$entitytype_label)) == group1_label)
        x2 <- which(levels(factor(emm_entity_df$entitytype_label)) == group2_label)
        y_pos <- y_max + (i * y_step)
 
        p1 <- p1 +
          annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x1, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("segment", x = x2, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +

      }

  }
 
  p1 <- p1 + paper_theme(title_map[[var_name]], tag_map[[var_name]],

  # Main Effect of Mental Faculty
 
  raw_data_mf <- supp %>%

  emm_mf_df <- as.data.frame(emm_mentalfaculty_expaov$emmeans) %>%

  p2 <- ggplot() +

  if (nrow(sig_mf) > 0) {

    y_max <- max(emm_mf_df$upper, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_step <- (y_range[2] - y_max) / (nrow(sig_mf) + 2)
 
    for (i in 1:nrow(sig_mf)) {
      contrast_parts <- strsplit(as.character(sig_mf$contrast[i]), " - ")[[1]]
      group1 <- trimws(gsub("^\\(|\\)$", "", contrast_parts[1]))

      if (!is.na(group1_label) && !is.na(group2_label)) {

          annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x1, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("segment", x = x2, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +
          annotate("text", x = (x1 + x2)/2, y = y_pos + y_step/4,
                   label = ifelse(sig_mf$p.value[i] < .001, "***",
                                  ifelse(sig_mf$p.value[i] < .01, "**", "*")),
                   size = 5)
      }
    }
  }
 
  p2 <- p2 + paper_theme(title_map[[var_name]], tag_map[[var_name]],

  ggsave(filename = paste0("experimental anova plots unweighted/", var_name, "_mentalfaculty_paper.png"),
         plot = p2, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
 
  # Interaction Effect
 
  raw_data_int <- supp %>%
    filter(!is.na(!!sym(var_name)) & !is.na(mentalfaculty) & !is.na(entitytype)) %>%
    mutate(
      mentalfaculty_label = recode_mentalfaculty(mentalfaculty),
      entitytype_label = recode_entitytype(entitytype)
    )
 
  emm_interaction_df <- as.data.frame(emm_entity_by_mf_expaov) %>%
    rename(fitted = emmean, se = SE) %>%

      mentalfaculty_label = recode_mentalfaculty(mentalfaculty),
      entitytype_label = recode_entitytype(entitytype)
    )
 
  pairs_interaction_df <- as.data.frame(pairwise_results_expaov)
  sig_interaction <- pairs_interaction_df %>% filter(p.value < 0.05)
 
  n_entities <- length(levels(raw_data_int$entitytype))
  gold_navy_ramp <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFD700", "#1A1A2E"))(n_entities)
 
  p3 <- ggplot() +
    geom_violin(data = raw_data_int,
                aes(x = mentalfaculty_label, y = !!sym(var_name), fill = entitytype_label),
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), alpha = 0.5, color = NA, width = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = emm_interaction_df,
               aes(x = mentalfaculty_label, y = fitted, group = entitytype_label),
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), size = 3) +
    geom_errorbar(data = emm_interaction_df,
                  aes(x = mentalfaculty_label, ymin = lower, ymax = upper, group = entitytype_label),
                  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.25, linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = gold_navy_ramp) +
    labs(x = "Mental Faculty", fill = "Entity Type")
 
  if (nrow(sig_interaction) > 0) {
    y_range <- range(raw_data_int[[var_name]], na.rm = TRUE)
    y_max <- max(emm_interaction_df$upper, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_step <- (y_range[2] - y_max) / (nrow(sig_interaction) + 2)
 
    entity_levels <- levels(emm_interaction_df$entitytype)
    mf_levels <- levels(factor(emm_interaction_df$mentalfaculty_label))
    dodge_width <- 0.8
 
    for (i in 1:nrow(sig_interaction)) {
      mf_level <- recode_mentalfaculty(sig_interaction$mentalfaculty[i])
      mf_idx <- which(mf_levels == mf_level)
 
      contrast_parts <- strsplit(as.character(sig_interaction$contrast[i]), " - ")[[1]]
      entity1 <- trimws(contrast_parts[1])
      entity2 <- trimws(contrast_parts[2])
 
      entity1_idx <- which(entity_levels == entity1)
      entity2_idx <- which(entity_levels == entity2)
 
      offset1 <- (entity1_idx - (n_entities + 1)/2) * (dodge_width / n_entities)
      offset2 <- (entity2_idx - (n_entities + 1)/2) * (dodge_width / n_entities)
 
      x1 <- mf_idx + offset1
      x2 <- mf_idx + offset2
      y_pos <- y_max + (i * y_step)
 
      p3 <- p3 +
        annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos, linewidth = 0.5) +
        annotate("segment", x = x1, xend = x1, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +
        annotate("segment", x = x2, xend = x2, y = y_pos, yend = y_pos - y_step/4, linewidth = 0.5) +
        annotate("text", x = (x1 + x2)/2, y = y_pos + y_step/4,
                 label = ifelse(sig_interaction$p.value[i] < .001, "***",
                                ifelse(sig_interaction$p.value[i] < .01, "**", "*")),
                 size = 4)
    }
  }
 
  p3 <- p3 + paper_theme(title_map[[var_name]], tag_map[[var_name]],
                          spec_dv$min, spec_dv$max, spec_dv$breaks, show_legend = TRUE)
 
  ggsave(filename = paste0("experimental anova plots unweighted/", var_name, "_interaction_paper.png"),
         plot = p3, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
 
  # Store plots
  plots_list_expaov[[var_name]] <- list(
    main_entity = p1,
    main_mentalfaculty = p2,
    interaction = p3
  )
 
  # Print plots
  print(p1)
  print(p2)
  print(p3)
}
 
# Save the APA summary workbook (ANOVA table w/ partial eta-sq + CI,
# plus all pairwise contrast tables w/ CI, one sheet per DV)
saveWorkbook(expsection_anovas_workbook, "experimental_anovas_apa_results_unweighted.xlsx",
             overwrite = TRUE)
 
# Combine figures with patchwork
# Split the per-DV plot list into three sets: entity-type main effect,

plots_entity <- lapply(plots_list_expaov, `[[`, "main_entity")
plots_mf     <- lapply(plots_list_expaov, `[[`, "main_mentalfaculty")
plots_interaction <- lapply(plots_list_expaov, `[[`, "interaction")
 
# Helper: combine plots into rows (character vectors of variable names),
# stack the rows, apply the shared FigS3-style layout/theme, and save
# both a PNG and a PDF.
combine_and_save <- function(plot_list, rows_layout, filename_prefix, width, height) {
  row_plots <- lapply(rows_layout, function(row_vars) {
    Reduce(`|`, lapply(row_vars, function(v) plot_list[[v]]))
  })
  combined <- Reduce(`/`, row_plots)
 
  n_rows <- length(rows_layout)
  n_cols_max <- max(sapply(rows_layout, length))
 
  combined <- combined +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect", heights = rep(.7, n_rows), widths = rep(.7, n_cols_max)) +
    plot_annotation() &
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.margin = margin(.1, .1, .1, .1, unit = "in")
    )
 
  ggsave(paste0(filename_prefix, ".png"), combined, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  ggsave(paste0(filename_prefix, ".pdf"), combined, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
 
  combined
}

```{r exploratory 2 body, no body x 2 mind, no mind}
 
# Exploratory 2 (body, no body) x 2 (mind, no mind) contrasts
# entity (1 = AI, -1 = robot, 0 = robot/AI)
# mental faculty (-1 = none, .25 = agency, .25 = emotion, .25 = reasoning, .25 = sentience)
 
# Create workbook
test_anovas_workbook <- createWorkbook()
options("openxlsx.numFmt" = "0.000")
wrap_format <- createStyle(numFmt = "0.00", wrapText = TRUE)
 
# Create an empty list to store results
results_list_testaov <- list()
plots_list_testaov <- list()
 
set.seed(12345)
 
# Set sum-to-zero contrasts to interpret Type 3 ANOVAs
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
 
# Ensure correct factor order for Type 3 ANOVAs
supp$entitytype <- factor(supp$entitytype, levels = c("AI", "robot", "robotAI"))
supp$mentalfaculty <- factor(supp$mentalfaculty, levels = (c("agent", "emotion", "reasoning",
                                                             "sentience", "none")))
 
# Loop through each dependent variable
for (var_name in names(dependent_vars)) {
 
  sheet_name <- dependent_vars[[var_name]]
 
  # Create formula dynamically — experimental factors + demographic covariates
  formula_testaov <- as.formula(paste(
    var_name,
    "~ entitytype + mentalfaculty + entitytype:mentalfaculty",
    "+ agecen + gender + raceethnicity + intcen"
  ))
 
  # Run unweighted linear model
  model_testaov <- lm(formula_testaov, data = supp, na.action = na.omit)
 
  # Type 3 ANOVA
  testaov_result <- car::Anova(model_testaov, type = 3)
 
  # Tidy results
  tidy_testaov <- tidy(testaov_result)
 
  # ==================== PARTIAL ETA-SQUARED + 95% CI ====================
  eta_sq_testaov <- effectsize::eta_squared(testaov_result, partial = TRUE, ci = 0.95) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::rename(term = Parameter,
                  partial_eta_sq = Eta2_partial,
                  eta_sq_ci_low = CI_low,
                  eta_sq_ci_high = CI_high) %>%
    dplyr::select(term, partial_eta_sq, eta_sq_ci_low, eta_sq_ci_high)
 
  residual_df_testaov <- tidy_testaov$df[tidy_testaov$term == "Residuals"]
 
  tidy_testaov <- tidy_testaov %>%
    left_join(eta_sq_testaov, by = "term") %>%
    mutate(
      apa_effect_size = ifelse(
        !is.na(partial_eta_sq),
        sprintf("\u03b7\u00b2p = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]",
                partial_eta_sq, eta_sq_ci_low, eta_sq_ci_high),
        NA_character_
      ),
      apa_full = ifelse(
        !is.na(partial_eta_sq),
        sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.2f, p %s, \u03b7\u00b2p = %.3f, 95%% CI [%.3f, %.3f]",
                df, residual_df_testaov, statistic,
                ifelse(p.value < .001, "< .001", paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))),
                partial_eta_sq, eta_sq_ci_low, eta_sq_ci_high),
        NA_character_
      )
    )
  # ============================================================================
 
  print(tidy_testaov)
 
  # Mind x body contrasts — covariates held at mean/reference via emmeans
  emm_testaov <- emmeans(model_testaov, ~ entitytype + mentalfaculty + entitytype:mentalfaculty)
 
  contrasts_interaction <- contrast(emm_testaov, interaction = list(
      entitytype    = list(AI_vs_robot = c(0, 1, -1)),
      mentalfaculty = list(none_vs_faculty = c(-1, .25, .25, .25, .25))
  ))
 
  emm_entity <- emmeans(model_testaov, ~ entitytype)
  contrasts_entity <- contrast(emm_entity, list(
      AI_vs_robot = c(0, 1, -1)
  ))
 
  emm_faculty <- emmeans(model_testaov, ~ mentalfaculty)
  contrasts_mentalfaculty <- contrast(emm_faculty, list(
      none_vs_faculty = c(-1, .25, .25, .25, .25)
  ))
 
  # ==================== 95% CIs FOR CUSTOM CONTRASTS ====================
  # infer = c(TRUE, TRUE) -> CI (lower.CL/upper.CL) + test stat + p-value together
  contrasts_interaction_df <- as.data.frame(summary(contrasts_interaction, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  contrasts_entity_df <- as.data.frame(summary(contrasts_entity, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
  contrasts_mentalfaculty_df <- as.data.frame(summary(contrasts_mentalfaculty, infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)))
 
  apa_mdiff2 <- function(df) {
    df %>% mutate(apa_contrast = sprintf("Mdiff = %.2f, 95%% CI [%.2f, %.2f], p %s",
                                          estimate, lower.CL, upper.CL,
                                          ifelse(p.value < .001, "< .001",
                                                 paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p.value)))))
  }
  contrasts_interaction_df <- apa_mdiff2(contrasts_interaction_df)
  contrasts_entity_df <- apa_mdiff2(contrasts_entity_df)
  contrasts_mentalfaculty_df <- apa_mdiff2(contrasts_mentalfaculty_df)
  # ==============================================================================
 
  # Store results
  results_list_testaov[[var_name]] <- list(
    model_testaov = model_testaov,
    anova_testaov = tidy_testaov,
    eta_sq_testaov = eta_sq_testaov,                          # NEW
    emm_testaov = emm_testaov,
    contrasts_interaction = contrasts_interaction,
    contrasts_entity = contrasts_entity,
    contrasts_mentalfaculty = contrasts_mentalfaculty,
    contrasts_interaction_df = contrasts_interaction_df,       # NEW
    contrasts_entity_df = contrasts_entity_df,                 # NEW
    contrasts_mentalfaculty_df = contrasts_mentalfaculty_df    # NEW
  )
 
  # Add worksheet (one per DV)
  addWorksheet(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name)
 
  current_row <- 1
 
  # Write ANOVA results (now includes partial eta-sq + CI columns)
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, "ANOVA Results (with partial eta-squared and 95% CI)", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1
  aov_df_testaov <- tidy_testaov
  aov_df_testaov <- cbind(Variable = rownames(aov_df_testaov), aov_df_testaov)
  rownames(aov_df_testaov) <- NULL
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, aov_df_testaov, startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + nrow(aov_df_testaov) + 3
 
  # Write model summary
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, "Model Summary", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1
  model_summary_testaov <- summary(model_testaov)
  model_coef_df_testaov <- as.data.frame(model_summary_testaov$coefficients)
  model_coef_df_testaov <- cbind(Variable = rownames(model_coef_df_testaov), model_coef_df_testaov)
  rownames(model_coef_df_testaov) <- NULL
 
  # Relabel coefficient terms
  model_coef_df_testaov <- model_coef_df_testaov %>%
    mutate(Variable = case_when(
      # Experimental main effects
      Variable == "mentalfaculty1" ~ "mentalfaculty: agency",
      Variable == "mentalfaculty2" ~ "mentalfaculty: emotion",
      Variable == "mentalfaculty3" ~ "mentalfaculty: reasoning",
      Variable == "mentalfaculty4" ~ "mentalfaculty: sentience",
      Variable == "entitytype1"    ~ "entitytype: AI",
      Variable == "entitytype2"    ~ "entitytype: robot",
      # Interactions
      Variable == "entitytype1:mentalfaculty1" ~ "entitytype: AI × mentalfaculty: agency",
      Variable == "entitytype2:mentalfaculty1" ~ "entitytype: robot × mentalfaculty: agency",
      Variable == "entitytype1:mentalfaculty2" ~ "entitytype: AI × mentalfaculty: emotion",
      Variable == "entitytype2:mentalfaculty2" ~ "entitytype: robot × mentalfaculty: emotion",
      Variable == "entitytype1:mentalfaculty3" ~ "entitytype: AI × mentalfaculty: reasoning",
      Variable == "entitytype2:mentalfaculty3" ~ "entitytype: robot × mentalfaculty: reasoning",
      Variable == "entitytype1:mentalfaculty4" ~ "entitytype: AI × mentalfaculty: sentience",
      Variable == "entitytype2:mentalfaculty4" ~ "entitytype: robot × mentalfaculty: sentience",
      # Continuous covariates
      Variable == "agecen" ~ "covariate: age (centered)",
      Variable == "intcen" ~ "covariate: internet use (centered)",
      # Multicategorical covariates (sum-contrast coefficients)
      grepl("^gender", Variable) ~ gsub("^gender", "covariate: gender ", Variable),
      grepl("^raceethnicity", Variable) ~ gsub("^raceethnicity", "covariate: race/ethnicity ", Variable),
      TRUE ~ Variable
    ))
 
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, model_coef_df_testaov, startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + nrow(model_coef_df_testaov) + 3
 
  # Write interaction contrast (now includes 95% CI + apa_contrast columns)
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, "Interaction Contrast (AI vs Robot x Some Faculty vs None), with 95% CI", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, contrasts_interaction_df, startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + nrow(contrasts_interaction_df) + 3
 
  # Write entity main effect contrast (now includes 95% CI + apa_contrast columns)
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, "Entity Contrast (AI vs Robot), with 95% CI", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, contrasts_entity_df, startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + nrow(contrasts_entity_df) + 3
 
  # Write faculty main effect contrast (now includes 95% CI + apa_contrast columns)
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, "Faculty Contrast (None vs Some Faculty), with 95% CI", startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + 1
  writeData(test_anovas_workbook, sheet_name, contrasts_mentalfaculty_df, startRow = current_row)
  current_row <- current_row + nrow(contrasts_mentalfaculty_df) + 3
 
}
 
# Save the workbook
saveWorkbook(test_anovas_workbook, "mind_body_anovas_results_unweighted.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)
